chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Khashshab from Ibn Baqqah from Mu'adh from 'Amr ibn Jumay' (it was raised) to Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said:

Rasul Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever recites four verses from the beginning of Al-Baqarah, and the Verse of the Throne (Ayat al-Kursi), and two verses after it, and three verses from its end, will not see in himself or his wealth anything he dislikes, nor will Satan come near him, nor will he forget the Quran.'
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of reciting specific verses from Surah Al-Baqarah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the spiritual efficacy of reciting the opening and closing verses of Surah Al-Baqarah, a practice deeply rooted in Shia devotional tradition for warding off calamities. It emphasizes both external protection from Satan and internal tranquility, ensuring the preservation of divine knowledge in the heart. The specific selection of verses underscores the Quran's role as a comprehensive source of healing and remembrance.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Khashhab, from Ibn Baqah, from Muaz, from Amro Bin Humeyd, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘

The one who recites four Verses from the beginning of (Surah) Al-Baqarah, and Ayat Al-Kursy [2:255], and two Verses after it, and three Verses from its end, would not see anything in himself and his wealth, anything which he dislikes, nor will Satanla come near him, nor would he forget the Quran’.
en.sarwar: 5. Hamid ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Khashshab from ibn Baqqah from Mu’adh from ‘Amr ibn Jami’ in a marfu’ manner from Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Whoever reads four verses from the beginning of Chapter 2 of the Holy Quran, verse 255- 257 and three verses from the end of this Chapter, he will not experience anything in his own self or property that he dislikes, Satan will not approach him and he will not forget the Holy Quran.’”
